scripts.build:assets: pnpm --filter @dukat/dashboard build && pnpm --filter @dukat/admin build && rm -rf ../dashboard/build/admin && cp -R ../admin/build ../dashboard/build/admin
scripts.configure:backups: wrangler r2 bucket lifecycle set dukat-backups --file r2-backup-lifecycle.json --force
scripts.deploy: pnpm configure:backups && pnpm build:assets && wrangler deploy
